meaning: Independent source-derived Event construction controls; occurrence, payload, references, time policy and immutable copying remain distinct.
input: Cover every primitive and selector-indexed reference carrier in occurrence and payload, signed Int64 bigint/string/safe-number input, binary64 finite decimals with negative-zero normalization, required and absent/present optional fields. Reject hostile descriptors and coercion without getters or caller mutation.
output: Observe closed inert deeply frozen outer, occurrence and payload records, exact source type/version, actual carrier and values, and detached copies. Equal occurrences do not imply deduplication; payload equality is not occurrence identity. No getters or serialization hooks may be invoked during observation.
time: Required time remains explicit input and never calls an extra clock. Generated time uses one deterministic fixture clock call after all input validation. Test distinct returned values, invalid/missing clock, invalid synchronous return, thrown sentinel identity and validation-before-clock order. Never use an ambient clock or a production provider.
references: References remain nonempty text values with source-bound selectors. They neither load referenced modules nor establish format, chronology, uniqueness, existence, embedding or registration.
coverage: Retain every source node. Build complete per-field positive/negative cases and structural descriptor cases at root, occurrence and payload; a capacity breach leaves the entire Event not_evaluable, never a passing prefix.
bounds: 4096 cases per whole node, 65536 project cases and 8 MiB serialized controls. Reuse existing bounded regular-file/subprocess limits; effect AST walk rejects more than 1000000 visits per module or depth 512.
effects: Source and emitted JavaScript Event-only closures receive the shared bounded native AST audit, with independent Event definition, phase, complete module inventory, file hashes, artifact currentness and exact native import guards. Source audit includes finite-unmet Events. Preserve all State Machine audit identities and its parser bytes. This is a selected syntactic restriction, not universal purity, alias analysis or arbitrary Proxy/modified-intrinsic isolation.
compatibility: Preserve all 51 predecessor capsule sources, existing domain generators, source schema, references, selection/defaults and standalone observers. No SFOL, AlchLang, dependency installation, publication, persistence, dispatch, admission or production effect.
binding: Independently observe the frozen callable and its closed, inert, deeply frozen descriptor against checked source identity, occurrence/time/payload contracts, complete reference bindings, original provider bytes and explicit non-publication/non-registration claims. Descriptor getters must never execute.
